_readme: Which project repos deliver a page brief to this site, and where it lives in each repo. Run `npm run sync-briefs` to fetch, validate and snapshot them into outDir; `npm run sync-briefs:check` validates the committed snapshots offline (CI). The contract a project must meet is docs/project-brief.md. Keys starting with _ are documentation.

_briefSchema.slug: required string. Must match a site project record: src/content/projects/<slug>.mdx.
_briefSchema.repo: required string. GitHub owner/name of the project repo. Private repos need GITHUB_BRIEFS_TOKEN in the environment (a fine-grained token with read access to that repo).
_briefSchema.path: optional string. Path of the brief inside the repo. Default docs/jameskidd.info.md.
_briefSchema.ref: optional string. Branch or tag to read. Default main.
